summary: 00879810 is not on the hit path: it negates its float and calls ApplyDamage, so it is a health-delta helper used only by the two damage-control repair steps 0093C770 and 0093C860. The impact path is 007BBCF0 -> 008777D0 -> vtable[1ACh] AddDamage -> 0087D730 -> 00879070 -> 00877B90. Maximum health +36Ch is written once at 0087BD01 from the vehicle-class descriptor's HP field [+354h]+48h, and the armour +368h the hit handler subtracts is the same descriptor's Armour at +4Ch.

routines.name: BSP_UnitInstance_ApplyHealthDelta
routines.evidence: Six instructions read from the listing. MOVSS XMM0,[00D7A208] loads -0.0f (bytes 00 00 00 80 at that address), SUBSS [ESP+4] makes -delta, PUSH ECX only allocates the outgoing slot because MOVSS [ESP],XMM0 overwrites it, ECX is never written so this passes through to 00879070.

routines.name: BSP_UnitInstance_ApplyHitRecord
routines.abi: __thiscall(void* unit, HitRecord* hit), RET 4, returns 1 in AL
routines.evidence: Argument from MOV EBX,[ESP+0x1C] at 008777D4 after SUB ESP,0x14 / PUSH EBX; return RET 4 at 00877A41. Hull pass 008777DD-008778D4, part pass 008778E4-00877A37.

routines.name: BSP_HitRecord_HullDamage
routines.formula: (hit+14h * ownerModifier - armourScaled) * weaponScale; not floored at zero
routines.evidence: Decompiled body; weaponScale is [hit+4h]->vtable[58h]() or 1.0f (00D7A24C), ownerModifier is BSP_GameplayModifiers_ProductForUnit(1, [[hit+4h]->vtable[108h]()+ACh]) gated on 00E0C978 and [00F88C30+94h].

routines.name: BSP_HitRecord_PartDamage
routines.abi: __thiscall(HitRecord*, float armourScaled, float partHitIndex) -> float in ST(0)
routines.formula: f = 1 - entry[i].+0Ch / hit+24h; if (hit+2Ch && f > 0) f = 1; max(0, f * hit+28h * ownerModifier - armourScaled) * weaponScale
routines.evidence: Decompiled body; the index reaches the entry through [hit+3Ch] + index*10h + 0Ch.

routines.name: BSP_RepairTask_RepairHull
routines.evidence: Full listing read. amount = task+28h * dt * settings+3B4h * unit+36Ch * rate; rate comes from task byte +45h and int +24h with settings+3D4h, then the gameplay-modifier product for kind 3. 00879810 is called with the positive amount, so health rises; the tail clamps with 00877B90 when health exceeds max.

corrections.what: the writer of the unit's maximum health +36Ch
corrections.was: docs/UNIT_DAMAGE_AND_DEATH.md line 47 and its open questions: "no writer found"
corrections.is: 0087BD01 in 0087BCC0 stores [unit+354h]+48h into unit+36Ch, and 0087BD11 stores the same value into unit+370h
corrections.evidence: mcp__ghidra__search_byte_patterns over the whole program for every MOVSS [reg+36Ch],XMM0 and FSTP [reg+36Ch] encoding returned ten sites; only 0087BD01 sits in a routine that writes +368h, +36Ch, +370h and +378h of a +1188h unit instance in one block. +354h is the vehicle-class descriptor (docs/UNIT_INSTANCE_UPDATE.md line 321) and its +48h is the Lua HP key, +4Ch the Armour key (docs/VEHICLE_CLASS_FIELDS.md lines 65-66).

corrections.was: the packet brief's premise that 00879810 is a step on the hit path
corrections.is: a health-delta helper: it negates its float argument and calls 00879070, so a positive argument repairs. Both callers are damage-control repair steps
corrections.evidence: The six-instruction listing at 00879810 plus the constant -0.0f at 00D7A208, and the debug literal "Ship Repaired Fire && Leak %s Hp %6f %f" at 0093CAD1 in their common caller 0093CA20.
